decisions.decision: Build the receiving side now, as part of the T-432 build task. Do not wait on this input task. (1) Add a POST /hooks/clerk route to the centre Worker in cloud/src. It checks the Svix signature with CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET, using the webhook-id.timestamp.rawBody scheme from the Dodo route, and rejects requests older than 5 minutes. session.ended, session.revoked and session.removed add the sid to the ended list and end its embed sessions. user.deleted runs the section 5 deletion. Until the secret is set, the route answers 503. (2) Write a probe that signs events with a locally generated whsec_ against a local centre. (3) Deploy revops-centre and confirm an unsigned POST is refused. (4) Rewrite needs_from_owner here with the full live URL (https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/hooks/clerk), the four events, and the exact wrangler secret put CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET command. Keep this task with Bharath.
decisions.why: No Clerk code exists in cloud/src yet. Spec row 6 (TANTRA_INSOURCE_SPEC.md:181) needs a second Clerk endpoint on the Worker. T-448 Q9 assigned the dashboard step to Bharath. Creating a signing secret in an outside service's dashboard is a credential step we never approve.
